responsibility: This subtarget header customizes the m68k backend for GNU/Linux ELF systems. It overrides assembler, preprocessor, and linker specs; selects Linux dynamic linker names; defines ABI details such as stack alignment, return-value registers, structure return behavior, and basic C type sizes; provides Linux-specific profiling and trampoline cache-flush sequences; controls jump-table emission and BSS handling; and installs sync libcalls. In effect, it is the OS/ABI glue layer between the generic m68k code generator and Linux runtime, assembler, and linker conventions.
